principle: Finish the information, resource, routing, product-module and cross-surface architecture before any new full-site layout design. Existing layouts are temporary carriers only and are not design authority for the next visual system.

designFreeze.rule: Do not continue incremental redesign of existing layouts during architecture work.

afterArchitecture.rule: Start from a clean layout system and discard prior redesign assumptions.
afterArchitecture.reference: Use the current Sites design progress as the primary design reference together with the stabilized architecture.
afterArchitecture.preserve: content, routes where still useful, resource architecture, verified assets, canonical identities
afterArchitecture.discard: previous page-layout redesigns, accumulated visual patches, obsolete template assumptions
